FINDING (medium, test_coverage): F008 tests do not cover the quota “caps present, calibration absent” non-optimistic status case. Evidence: tests cover capabilities non-optimism around [test_config_inventory_f008.py](/Users/bayesian/Documents/GitHub/DontPanic/scripts/dontpanic_orchestrate/tests/test_config_inventory_f008.py:323), but no equivalent quota calibration assertion. Recommendation: add a test that monkeypatches calibration absent with caps present and expects a non-ok required status.
